section_summary.extract_value: This section presents between-group differences in BAS-2 scores comparing men and women, and across universities. Item-level t-tests (Bonferroni-corrected) revealed that men scored significantly higher on 5 items (#2, 5, 6, 7, 9) while women scored higher on item #10. Overall BAS-2 total scores were significantly higher in men (t(1031)=2.37, p=.021), though the effect size was small (d=0.15). A univariate ANOVA showed no significant differences in body appreciation across universities (F(6,1025)=0.69, p=.660).
